exploit_name: fulfillRedeem may corrupt share price and allow over-redemption
description: Share price calculation uses max(0, balance - liabilities), which inflates prices when vault balance is insufficient to cover redemption liabilities.
root_cause: Share price calculation uses max(0, balance - liabilities), which inflates prices when vault balance is insufficient to cover redemption liabilities.
fix_description: Use actual available balance for price calculation, not max-clamped value.
notes: Redeemers can claim excess assets, draining vault beyond intended limits.
